title: Nepal flood and slope failure, 26 Aug 2026 (Bhote Koshi / Trishuli, Rasuwa)
note: This is a documented timeline, not an animated river rise. GloFAS and rain data show no spike for this event.
limitations: Debris flows and landslide-dam or glacier-lake floods are not visible to a river model: the 26 Aug 2026 event was a rock-and-ice slope failure that GloFAS discharge and rain data do not show.
Counts of buildings and people are estimates from satellite mapping.

timeline.text: Onset of the rock-and-ice slope failure in the Bhote Koshi / Trishuli area, Rasuwa.
Barrier lake overflow. BIPAD Galchi river station (id 281) readings exist only from 28 Aug.
